notes.title: Slum Guide Is Now Available To Purchase!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125155/f38b24bd398a923de98372743f8d4c08a808ecc1.png

To celebrate the launch, we're offering a 20% OFF launch discount! Now’s the perfect time to dive into the gritty, fully voiced world of Slum Town and begin your adventure!

Grab your copy now at 20% OFF Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3070560/Slum_Guide/

Let’s explore Slum Town together! 🎮
